definitions.explanation: The outer or visible side of something.
The outdoors; the public space outside.
The outward appearance shown to others.

examples.japanese: {紙|かみ}の{表|おもて}に{書|か}いてください。
examples.english: Please write on the front side of the paper.

notes:
{表|おもて} means 'front,' 'surface,' or 'outside,' contrasting with {裏|うら} (back).

Common expressions:
- {表|おもて}と{裏|うら}: front and back, both sides
- {表|おもて}に{出|で}る: to go outside; to become public
- {表|おもて}{向|む}き: ostensible, on the surface
- {表|おもて}{通|どお}り: main street

Figurative usage:
- {表|おもて}の{顔|かお}: public face
- {表|おもて}に{出|だ}す: to reveal, to make public

Note: Also read as ひょう in compounds like {表|ひょう} (table/chart) or {発表|はっぴょう} (announcement).
